QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_4

question.text: Which of the following is NOT listed in Chapter 2 as a stakeholder of the Social Stock Exchange ecosystem?

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 2 enumerates SSE stakeholders as: Trading Members, NPOs, FPEs, Market Infrastructure Institutions (stock exchanges, clearing corporations, depositories), Social Impact Assessors, Information Repositories, Regulators (SEBI), SRO (ICAI-notified 'Institute of Social Auditors of India'), and Investors. Resolution Professionals under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code have no role in SSE. The Trap: A, B and C are all explicitly named in Section 2.2. Option D sounds plausible because an NPO in distress might superficially resemble a corporate insolvency, but NPOs generally cannot be subjected to CIRP under IBC in the same way, and no such role exists in the SSE ecosystem. Cross-Exam Context: III-A / III-C (Compliance) covers CIRP stakeholder mapping. XXIII intentionally excludes this to keep scope on social-sector certification. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When mapping stakeholders in your engagement letter, list each one with their touchpoint in the Annual Impact Report cycle (SIA issues assurance -> SRO reviews conduct -> IR hosts information -> Depository holds ZCZP demat) — a crisp stakeholder-role table avoids scope creep during fieldwork.
